title: Overview of Our Privacy Commitment
paragraphs: Hostixie respects the privacy of the individuals whose personal data we process and is committed to handling personal information lawfully, fairly, transparently, and securely.
This Privacy Policy explains how Hostixa SRL, operating under the brand name Hostixie, collects, uses, stores, shares, and otherwise processes personal data in connection with:
Hostixie primarily provides business-to-business (B2B) services.

Although our clients are generally companies and organizations, we may process personal data relating to individuals who represent or work for those organizations, including directors, employees, contractors, business owners, consultants, prospective clients, suppliers, partners, research participants, and other professional contacts.

title: Key Terms and Definitions
paragraphs: For this Privacy Policy:
bullets: "Company," "Hostixie," "we," "our," or "us" means Hostixa SRL, operating under the Hostixie brand.
"Client" means a business, organization, professional, entrepreneur, or other commercial entity that requests or purchases our services.
"Business Contact" means an individual acting professionally on behalf of a company or organization, including directors, employees, owners, contractors, consultants, and representatives.
"Personal Data" means information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

"Processing" means any operation performed on Personal Data, including collection, recording, organization, storage, use, consultation, disclosure, transmission, modification, restriction, or deletion.
"Controller" means the organization that determines the purposes and means of processing Personal Data.
"Processor" means an organization processing Personal Data on behalf of a Controller.
"Client Data" means information supplied by a Client in connection with a Project.
"Service" means the advertising, marketing, consulting, media, research, PR, communication, design, or related professional services provided by Hostixie.
"Third-Party Service Provider" means an external company that provides technology, media, research, payment, communications, professional, or other services used by Hostixie.
"Website" means the Hostixie website available through hostixie.com.
"Cookie" means a small file or similar technology stored or accessed through a user's browser or device.

title: Data Retention
paragraphs: Hostixie retains Personal Data only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected and for any applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, accounting, dispute-resolution, or security requirements.
Retention periods depend on the type of information and processing purpose.

title: Business Enquiries
paragraphs: We may retain enquiry information for the period reasonably necessary to respond, follow up, and maintain an appropriate record of business discussions.

title: Client and Contractual Records
paragraphs: Client, contract, invoice, transaction, and accounting information may be retained for the periods required by applicable Romanian accounting, tax, contractual, and legal requirements.

title: Project Data
paragraphs: Hostixie may retain project records for the duration of the Client relationship and for an appropriate period afterward for contractual, operational, evidential, or legal purposes.

title: Client-Supplied Personal Data
paragraphs: Where Hostixie acts as Processor, Client instructions, contractual terms, and applicable law govern retention. At the end of the relevant Services, Personal Data may be returned, deleted, or anonymized as required by those arrangements.

title: Research Data
paragraphs: Identifiable research information will be retained only as long as needed for the applicable research purpose or contractual requirements. Where appropriate, we may then anonymize information for statistical or analytical purposes.

title: Marketing Data
paragraphs: We may retain direct-marketing information while the relevant business relationship or marketing purpose continues. If you unsubscribe or object, we may retain limited suppression information to ensure we continue to respect your preference.

title: Recruitment Data
paragraphs: We will retain applicant information for a reasonable recruitment period and, where appropriate and lawfully permitted, for consideration for future opportunities.

title: Your Data Protection Rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law and the circumstances of the processing, you may have the following rights:

title: Right of Access
paragraphs: You may request confirmation of whether we process your Personal Data and obtain a copy of relevant Personal Data.

title: Right to Rectification
paragraphs: You may request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.

title: Right to Erasure
paragraphs: In certain circumstances, you may request deletion of Personal Data. This right is not absolute and may not apply where law requires retention or where it is necessary for legitimate legal purposes.

title: Right to Restriction
paragraphs: You may request that we restrict processing in certain circumstances.

title: Right to Data Portability
paragraphs: Where applicable, you may request certain Personal Data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.

title: Right to Object
paragraphs: You may object to certain processing based on legitimate interests.

title: Direct Marketing Objection
paragraphs: You may object to processing of your Personal Data for direct marketing at any time.

title: Withdrawal of Consent
paragraphs: Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw consent at any time.

title: Automated Decision-Making
paragraphs: Where applicable, you may have rights relating to decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects. Hostixie does not ordinarily use solely automated decision-making of this nature for Website visitors or B2B Clients.

title: Exercising Your Rights
paragraphs: To exercise a privacy right, contact:
Email: info@hostixie.com
Please provide enough information for us to identify the relevant Personal Data and understand your request.
We may request appropriate verification where reasonably necessary to prevent unauthorized disclosure or deletion of Personal Data.
We will respond in accordance with applicable data-protection law.

title: Right to Lodge a Complaint
paragraphs: If you believe that the processing of your Personal Data infringes applicable data-protection law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority.
For Hostixie's Romanian establishment, the relevant supervisory authority is:
Autoritatea Națională de Supraveghere a Prelucrării Datelor cu Caracter Personal (ANSPDCP)
National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing
Bucharest, Romania
You may also have the right to contact another competent supervisory authority where applicable under the GDPR.
We encourage you to contact Hostixie first if you have concerns so that we have an opportunity to address them.

title: Links to Other Websites
paragraphs: Our Website may contain links to third-party websites. This Privacy Policy applies only to processing carried out by Hostixie and does not govern independent websites or services operated by third parties. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of external websites before providing Personal Data.

title: Children’s Privacy
paragraphs: Hostixie is a B2B service provider, and our Services are not directed toward children. We do not knowingly seek to collect Personal Data from individuals under 18 through our business enquiry or professional service processes. If we become aware that Personal Data relating to a child has been submitted to us without an appropriate legal basis, we will take reasonable steps to review and, where appropriate, delete the information.
